name: build-beamer-slides
title_zh: Beamer 幻灯片从排版到渲染一条龙
tagline_zh: 不用再为 LaTeX 排版反复编译调试。它自带一套不刺眼的浅色主题，单页改、整份做、视觉检查都行。
tagline_en: Skip the compile-check loop. It ships a restrained light theme, handles single slides or whole decks, and leaves.
desc_en: Design, implement, render, and visually review polished Beamer slides. Use for a new deck, a single slide, slide-by-slide collaboration, layout repair, or a user-defined visual style; use the bundled restrained light style by default and leave deck-level narrative order to the user unless they ask for help with it.
why_zh: 把设计、实现、渲染、视觉复查收进同一循环，默认风格克制不抢内容。
why_en: One loop for design, implementation, rendering, and visual review. Default style stays quiet; it won't hijack your deck's story.
limit_zh: 只认 Beamer/LaTeX 生态，不碰 Markdown 或 PPT 导出；默认浅色主题。
limit_en: Beamer/LaTeX only; no Markdown or PPT. Light theme by default; custom dark/flashy styles need your own template. Won't reorder your narrative unless.
title_en: Beamer slides: design, render, and review in one pass
